name: get_mission_brief
description: Read the assigned brief once at the start, then only for new business facts, changed constraints, or immediately before an offer. Reuse the result for identity questions and greetings. Follow conversation.action; end means close politely without another tool call.

name: report_observation
description: Save one new relevant business fact from this call. Generate a stable key yourself; never ask the participant for tool arguments. Do not record greetings or repeat an already saved fact.

key.description: Stable operation ID generated by you, not the caller.

text.description: The new business fact or essential missing detail.

name: submit_offer
description: Save the actual quote after refreshing the brief, using named fields rather than JSON text. price_inr is rupees, not paise. Send supplied relevant details only. Omitted optional details retain this call’s current quote; an empty string retracts a detail. Confirm only after explicit agreement. Never invent unknown terms or ask for irrelevant fields.

key.description: Generate a new operation ID whenever terms or confirmation change. Reuse an ID only for an identical retry.

revision.description: Current revision from the latest get_mission_brief result.

price_inr.description: Actual total in INR rupees, e.g. 1500.50. Do not multiply by 100. Never use zero for unknown.

description.description: The specific goods/service covered by this actual quote, including the fee/tax agreement.

confirmation.description: Use confirmed only after the participant explicitly agrees to the quote summary.

capacity.description: Capacity/quantity as whole digits only if relevant and supplied. Omit if unknown; empty string retracts a previously supplied value. Do not ask delivery about capacity.

ready_at.description: Exact readiness/access ISO datetime with timezone offset, using the brief date and zone. Omit if not supplied; empty string retracts a previous time.

setup_minutes.description: Actual setup/installation duration in whole minutes if relevant. Zero means explicitly no setup time. Omit if unknown; empty string retracts a previous duration.

name: request_clarification
description: Record a missing essential organizer/service detail or callback request for the mission owner, then end politely. This does not arrange a callback. Generate a stable key yourself; never ask the participant for tool arguments.

key.description: Stable operation ID generated by you, not the caller.

text.description: The new business fact or essential missing detail.
